title: 第一卷 第14章 是、是你哥闫耀祖砸的！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

闫爱党穿着蓑衣，戴着雨帽，向着村委会跑去。

五六分钟后，闫爱党跑到村委会门口。

只见闫耀宗正坐在一楼办公室门口的台阶上。

闫爱党微微一愣，快步跑上前，干咳一声，道：“耀宗，你还没睡呢？村长让我过来，喊你去忠国家一趟！”

“雨声太吵，睡不着！”闫耀宗笑了笑，继续道，“村长让我去闫忠国家干什么？”

看着面带微笑，注视着自己的闫耀宗，闫爱党忍不住挑了挑眉，实在是对方的目光太坦然了，好似真不知道闫忠国被打的事情。

“不久前，忠国被人从窗口拉出去……忠国说，是你打了他！”闫爱党道。

闫耀宗慢悠悠的站起身，拍了怕屁股上的灰尘。

闫爱党还以为他要跟自己去闫忠国家，道：“耀宗，你穿件蓑衣，再跟我走吧！”

“跟你去哪儿？”

“去忠国家啊！”

“凭什么？”

“啊？”

迎上闫爱党错愕的目光，闫耀宗脸上笑容不减，道：“闫忠国说是我打的他，那就是我打的？他说吃屎能长生，你吃不吃？”

闫爱党真没想到闫耀宗会说这种话，不由得涨红脸，道：“耀宗，你说话别这么难听嘛。如果不是你打的忠国，那你就跟我过去，把事情讲清楚就行了！”

“呵呵！”

闫耀宗抬手指向村委会二楼，道：“二楼房间的玻璃窗，被人砸了。我说是闫忠国砸的，你让他过来，把话说清楚！”

“耀宗，你这话就有点胡搅蛮缠了。这事情，之前振东就去找过忠国了……”

“关我屁事？”闫耀宗打断闫爱党的话，转身向着办公室内走去，一边说道：“你回去告诉闫忠国，说我打了他，那就要拿出证据。没证据，那叫污蔑。还有，我准备睡觉了，别再来烦我！”

“闫耀宗，是村长让我来喊你的。你连村长的话都不听了？”

“你说村长让你来喊我，就是村长让你来喊我的？闫爱党，你这人，脑子是不是缺根筋？”

闫耀宗走到办公室门口，扭头看向脸色难看无比的闫爱党，“有什么事情，让他们明早来村委会讲！”

“你……”闫爱党气得抬手指着闫耀宗。

Page (1/3)

Yan Aidang ran towards the village committee wearing a raincoat and a rain hat.

Five or six minutes later, Yan Aidang ran to the door of the village committee.

Yan Yaozong was seen sitting on the steps at the door of the office on the first floor.

Yan Aidang was stunned for a moment, then hurried forward, coughed dryly, and said, "Yao Zong, are you still awake? The village chief asked me to come over and tell you to go to Zhongguo!"

"The rain is too noisy and I can't sleep!" Yan Yaozong smiled and continued, "Why did the village chief ask me to go to Yan Zhong's country?"

Looking at Yan Yaozong who was looking at him with a smile, Yan Aidang couldn't help but raise his eyebrows. It was because the other person's eyes were too calm, as if he really didn't know about Yan Zhongguo's beating.

"Not long ago, Zhongguo was pulled out of the window... Zhongguo said it was you who beat him!" Yan Aidang said.

Yan Yaozong stood up slowly and wiped the dust off his butt.

Yan Aidang thought he was going to Yan Zhong's country with him, so he said, "Yao Zong, put on a raincoat and come with me!"

"Where are I going with you?"

"Go and be loyal to the country!"

"Why?"

"Huh?"

Meeting Yan Aidang's astonished gaze, Yan Yaozong's smile did not diminish and he said: "Yan Zhongguo said I beat him, so that's what I did? He said eating shit can lead to immortality, do you eat it or not?"

Yan Aidang really didn't expect Yan Yaozong to say such a thing. He couldn't help but blush and said, "Yao Zong, don't speak so harshly. If you weren't the one who beat Zhongguo, then just come with me and explain the matter clearly!"

"Haha!"

Yan Yaozong raised his hand and pointed to the second floor of the village committee and said: "The glass window of the room on the second floor was smashed. I said it was Yan Zhongguo. Ask him to come over and explain clearly!"

"Yao Zong, what you are saying is a bit confusing. Zhendong has gone to Zhong Guo before about this matter..."

"It's none of my business?" Yan Yaozong interrupted Yan Aidang, turned around and walked into the office, saying at the same time: "Go back and tell Yan Zhongguo that I beat him, and then you have to provide evidence. Without evidence, that's called slander. Also, I'm going to bed, don't bother me again!"

"Yan Yaozong, the village chief asked me to call you. You don't even listen to the village chief?"

"You said that the village chief asked you to call me, and the village chief asked you to call me? Yan Aidang, do you have a weak brain?"

Yan Yaozong walked to the door of the office and turned to look at Yan Aidang, who looked extremely ugly. "If you have anything to do, ask them to come to the village committee tomorrow morning to talk about it!"

"You..." Yan Aidang was so angry that he raised his finger and pointed at Yan Yaozong.
